title: Public Speaking with Confidence
description: Prepare and deliver a talk that people remember. Practice structure, voice, body language, nerves, Q&A, and a complete five-minute capstone presentation.

badge.name: Confident Voice
badge.description: Awarded for completing Public Speaking with Confidence.

lessons.title: Introduction: Public Speaking with Confidence - Lesson 1

content.text: In this lesson you'll learn about Introduction and how to apply it in real-world scenarios within the context of Public Speaking with Confidence.

This lesson covers the fundamentals of Introduction. You'll learn practical techniques you can apply immediately in your public speaking with confidence projects.

finalAssessment.title: Confident Voice Assessment
finalAssessment.intro: Answer all 8 questions. Score 80% or higher to earn the Confident Voice badge and certificate. You can retake the assessment if needed.

questions.explanation: Public Speaking with Confidence focuses on practical, usable skills.

questions.explanation: This course is designed for beginner learners.

questions.question: What do you earn on completion?
questions.explanation: Completing the course and assessment earns a badge and certificate.

questions.explanation: You can retake the assessment if you need to.
